title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_tmux_2_by_brian_p_hogan_htnfo (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_tmux_2_by_brian_p_hogan_htnfo' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the extent of control the malicious code may have gained, complete remediation cannot be guaranteed without further system recovery measures.
